capture_rules.row_images: INSERT uses NEW; DELETE uses OLD; UPDATE unions OLD and NEW scopes and dependent audiences before relationship mutation.
capture_rules.no_op: UPDATE captures only if at least one relevant column IS DISTINCT FROM its OLD value. Timestamp-only, secret-only and heartbeat-only changes do not capture.
capture_rules.privacy: Inbox rows contain family and scope identifiers only. Source values, credentials, paths, network metadata, payloads and raw event bodies never enter the browser protocol. Secret-bearing structured settings may trigger safe invalidation without copying their value.
capture_rules.scope_routing: Routes name the root family audience. Dependent private families require reverse lookup of affected owners, never broadcasting a user family to every library reader. Admin families always use the admin route even when another root route applies.
capture_rules.cascades: Before deleting a parent, capture its own and dependent family scopes while links remain readable. Child DELETE/SET NULL capture must not depend on reading the removed parent. Keep direct OLD foreign-key scopes; parent capture covers vanished join paths.
capture_rules.public_playlists: Playlist visibility flags grant no additional read authority. Owner/collaborator changes dirty the old and new personal audiences; loss of access sends an opaque personal reset.
capture_rules.expiry: Time passing creates no SQL change; expiry and continuously varying gauges need the declared bounded active-visible sampling policy.

authoritative-read.policy: No enabled ORM result-cache call or application resource response-cache decorator found for these readers; configuration alone does not enable result caching. Any later cache needs revision-aware keys or synchronous invalidation before it can satisfy live refresh.
authoritative-read.exclusions: OAuth revocation cache, DPoP replay protection, passkey challenges, external provider tokens, compiled metadata and media segment caches are not query-resource response caches.

dependency_rules.derivation: Resolve media_activities.user_id for changed song/album/artist/movie and related artwork or availability before deleting relation paths.
